paras: Trachylepis hemmingi, also known commonly as the Somali mabuya, is a species of skink, a lizard in the subfamily Mabuyinae of the family Scincidae. The species is endemic to Somalia.
The specific name, hemmingi, is in honor of English entomologist Christopher Francis Hemming, who collected the holotype.
The mode of reproduction of T. hemmingi is unknown.
